name: Undead survivor's kit
body:
Source Adventurer's Armory 2 pg. 17
Price 900 gp; Weight 3 lbs.
Category Kits
Description
Although this sturdy leather bandolier contains a few items to help combat undead foes, its primary purpose is to supply the right tools to recover from an undead attack and escape. This kit includes 4 potions of hide from undead, a potion of lesser restoration, 2 flasks of holy water, 2 doses of holy weapon balmACG, a vial of soul stimulantUE, and 2 vials of twitch tonicUE.
